description: This source file defines a module for fetching and listing organizations (tenants) associated with the current user. It exports an asynchronous function 'listOrganizations' that calls an API endpoint to retrieve organization data, normalizes, sorts, and returns the list.

methods.name: listOrganizations()
methods.description: Fetches the list of organizations (tenants) for the current user by calling the API, processes response data to normalize the organization identifiers and names, sorts them, and returns the list.
